resources.string: A small AI that lives on your phone. Tell it anything: your day, the music you love, what bugs you about sound. It turns your words into where your taste profile starts.
Private: it runs on your phone. Nothing you write ever leaves it.
One download of %1$s MB, from Google and Hugging Face. Wi-Fi recommended.
Qwen3 0.6B by the Qwen team, running on Google’s LiteRT-LM. Both open source (Apache 2.0).
JadOO AI is ready. Write anything in the taste profile.
JadOO AI needs a 64-bit ARM phone, and this one isn’t. The taste profile works fine without it.
The download stopped. Check your connection and tap Install to continue where it left off.
Not enough free space. JadOO AI needs about 600 MB free while it installs.

Install JadOO AI and write freely: your day, your music, what you love and what bugs you. It runs on your phone. Or skip this; your choices decide anyway.
